name: program_monitor
summary: Generalizes the single-program pump_ws_feed engine into a supervisor that spawns ONE asyncio subscriber task per registry entry where watch=true. Solana side uses logsSubscribe (mentions=[program_id]) over a raw RFC-6455 WebSocket (no external dep); Sui side uses suix_subscribeEvent {Package: <id>}. Per-program throughput is capped (default 50 events/s/program) so a chatty program can't blow out disk. Each emitted event is run through dimension_pack.emit() and append-written to ~/.cc/program_events/<chain>/<short>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl.
engine_pattern: asyncio supervisor over N stream subscribers. WS framing matches studio/solana/pump_ws_feed.py (mask client→server, parse 2/16/64-byte payload-len, ping on 60s recv timeout). Reconnect with exponential backoff (1s→30s). InferenceLogger crystal_id is captured at subscription open and reused as the anchor for every event emitted on that subscription's lifetime (so a full session is one chain segment).

five_canonical_frames_per_event.vector: fallback SHA-256 of canonical event JSON (no sentence axis for raw chain events)
five_canonical_frames_per_event.circle: * (raw events are leaves; recursion emerges in correlator)
five_canonical_frames_per_event.rgb: deterministic HSV(sub_dag=PLATFORMS hue 210°, cost_class=free sat 0.90, tier=external_chain_event val 0.55)
five_canonical_frames_per_event.fps: frame_pack populated for all 5 canonical FPS (24/30/60/90/120)

cli: start [--chain X] [--cat X] [--solana-wss URL] [--sui-wss URL] [--eps-cap N] [--duration N] [--max-programs N] [--verbose]
cc_dispatchers: cc programs-monitor-start [--chain X] [--cat X] [--duration N] [--max-programs N] [--verbose]
safety: READ-ONLY — no transactions sent, no accounts modified
Per-program EPS cap (default 50/s) so a token program can't blow disk
watch=false default for system token programs (catalog seed)
Reconnect backoff 1s→30s prevents tight reconnect loops on RPC outage
All events sink to user-home disk; no external upload
